name: KVFundaBench
description: KVFundaBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the effects of KV cache compression on large language models' fundamental capabilities across diverse tasks including world knowledge, commonsense reasoning, arithmetic reasoning, code generation, safety, and long-context understanding.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark for studying how KV cache compression affects LLM capabilities; it is not yet widely adopted as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on evaluating LLM capabilities under KV cache compression; proposes ShotKV compression method.
